subject: Urgent: Overrun allocation and discount framework for July surge
messages:
From: Kyle Tan <kyle.tan@novapay.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@novapay.com
Date: Mon, 10 Jul 2028 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Unexpected July spike — overrun allocation

Marissa,

Quick one — we saw an unplanned traffic spike over the weekend from a marketing campaign (referral partners). Usage jumped ~420% above our committed QPS for July 10–12 and we expect a continued elevated level through the launch window. Our finance team flagged the impending invoice for overrun as it pushes us far beyond quarterly budget.

Can Redwood provide a short-term allocation (temporary quota buffer) or any bridge credit while we finalize a quarterly true-up? We're hoping for either: (1) a provisional headroom for 7 days or (2) a mitigated overrun rate / one-time credit to cover the excess while we process an increased commit.

Attached is our internal usage export. Appreciate any immediate options — we need to give execs an answer before tomorrow's postmortem.

Thanks,
Kyle
Kyle Tan
Procurement, NovaPay

Attachment: usage_report_July10-14.csv
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Kyle Tan <kyle.tan@novapay.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 10 Jul 2028 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected July spike — overrun allocation

Kyle — thanks for the heads up and the export. Sorry you ran into this mid-launch. Short answers up front: yes, we can help immediately; we have two pragmatic paths we use in these cases.

Options (summary):
- 7-day provisional headroom: we can add a temporary quota uplift equal to 3x your committed QPS for 7 days. No immediate invoice change; usage above commit during that window would be tracked and reconciled at true-up.
- Blended overrun credit: a one-time 30% credit on the expected overrun charges for the affected window if you commit to a 3-month stepped commit increase (details below).

I'll circle in Ben and Laura to model the numbers and sign off on approval thresholds. Does NovaPay have a target cap on what you'd accept for any single invoice? If so, send that number and we'll push to contain it.

I'll follow up with a formal proposal attached.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: NP-Overrun-Proposal-20280715.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 11 Jul 2028 08:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: NovaPay overrun — pricing sketch

Marissa — I ran a quick back-of-envelope on the uplift and credit scenarios. Notes:
- If we provide 7-day provisional headroom (3x committed QPS), expected uncovered token delta is ~1.8M tokens -> ~$8.1k in overrun at list rates.
- Blended credit: 30% off the overrun reduces that to ~$5.7k. The revenue impact is visible but acceptable if NovaPay signs onto the 3-month stepped commit (adds ~25% committed capacity starting August).

Approval: I can approve up to a 25% one-time reduction on overrun fees with a documented mutual action plan and HubSpot deal note. Anything deeper needs Rev Ops review.

I'll add the numbers into NP-Overrun-Proposal-20280715.pdf and flag the approvable clause.

—Ben
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Jul 2028 15:09:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: NovaPay overrun — technical/ops constraints

Couple of operational bullets before we commit the uplift:
- We can spin the provisional uplift in the hosted cluster in ~45 mins. Will need explicit window start/end times from NovaPay (timezone sensitive).
- For billing, we'll tag all requests with a temporary policy ID and export the token-level detail for clean reconciliation.
- If NovaPay wants a hard cap (stop at X tokens), we can implement throttling but it will cause 429s for some requests — call that out to the ops team.

Marissa — include a callout in the proposal: desired uplift window, whether they want a hard cap, and acceptance of the reconciliation cadence (invoice true-up within 30 days).

—Laura
Director, Platform Operations
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Kyle Tan <kyle.tan@novapay.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 15 Jul 2028 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Final: provisional headroom + discount framework (proposal attached)

Kyle — thanks for the patience. Attached is a short proposal with two paths and an explicit reconciliation plan. TL;DR: we can activate a 7-day provisional headroom starting 2028-07-16 00:00 PDT (3x committed QPS) and apply a 25% one-time credit on overrun charges for the affected window if NovaPay agrees to a 3-month stepped commit increase (details in the doc).

Key callouts:
- Activation: Confirm by reply before 18:00 PDT today for a midnight activation tomorrow.
- Invoice control: We will tag the usage and issue an interim true-up invoice; any credit will be applied to that invoice. Ben has approved up to 25% credit in HubSpot note #9876543.
- Required data: Please confirm the desired hard cap (if any) and your billing contact for the true-up.

If you confirm activation, Laura will schedule the uplift and share the token export after the window closes.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
